# CEO Plan: User Dashboard Page
Generated by /plan-ceo-review (via /autoplan) on 2026-09-10
Branch: main | Mode: SELECTIVE EXPANSION
Repo: gstack-autoplan-chain-vsRLi1 (no remote)

## Baseline scope (what is being expanded)
A new post-login page at `/dashboard`, behind the feature flag `dashboard_landing` (default off, enabled per member cohort: 10% → 50% → 100%, gates defined in requirement R2 of the active plan). Three panels fed by one aggregate endpoint `GET /api/dashboard`: **QuickActions** (eligible actions from the existing action registry), **Notifications** (latest 20 member alerts with a "Mark all as read" confirmation modal), **Activity** (latest 20 audit-history records). Primary metric: login-to-first-completed-task time. Guardrails: completed-task rate and permission-error rate. A shared toast primitive provides non-blocking feedback. Detailed requirements live in the active plan file: R1-R14 are build requirements; R15 is the list of items deferred to TODOS.md (mirrored below).

**Blast radius** (used as the acceptance criterion below) = the files and routes the baseline plan already touches: the dashboard page, its three panels, the dialog wrapper, the toast primitive, the panel-state hook, the aggregate endpoint and its tests. The login flow, global shell/navigation, schema and repositories are outside it.

## Vision

### 10x Check
The 10x version of a post-login home is one that acts before you read. It prefetches its data on the login response, lands the first Tab stop and the first thumb-reach on "Resume assigned work", shows a "new since your last visit" divider in both lists so a returning member scans only what changed, carries an unread badge into every page's navigation so the dashboard is never the only place alerts live, and lets a member undo a bulk action instead of confirming it. Every panel degrades independently: a slow audit query never blanks the actions panel. Effort beyond the baseline plan: human ~3 weeks / CC ~1 day; this total includes the integration, cross-page QA and rollout work that the itemized E4-E8 estimates below (≈5 human-days / ≈2.5 CC-hours) do not carry individually.

### Platonic Ideal
Not produced: SELECTIVE EXPANSION mode skips this step by design.

## Scope Decisions

| # | Proposal | Effort (human / CC) | Decision | Reasoning |
|---|----------|--------|----------|-----------|
| E1 | Refetch on window focus/visibility, at most once per 60s, stale-while-revalidate; a 503, network or other request-level error during a background refetch keeps the stale render and shows an error toast, never a blank page; the refetch is suppressed while the mark-all-read dialog is open or its request is in flight, and the mutation's completion triggers the next refetch, so stale pre-mutation data can never repaint over a completed mutation | S (~2h / ~10min) | ACCEPTED | In blast radius; removes the stale-dashboard-after-lunch failure |
| E2 | Relative timestamps ("4 min ago") with the absolute value in `<time dateTime>` (JSX casing) and `title` | S (~1h / ~5min) | ACCEPTED | In blast radius; accessibility and scannability |
| E3 | Empty-state CTAs: QuickActions → none (empty means nothing to do); Notifications → link to the existing full notifications page; Activity → link to the registry's create-item action (the action the plan labels "create an item"; confirm its stable ID from the registry) **only when that action is present in the member's eligible `quickActions` envelope**, otherwise no CTA, so an ineligible member is never routed into a permission error | S (~1h / ~5min) | ACCEPTED | In blast radius; empty states are onboarding moments |
| E4 | QuickActions first in DOM and visual order at sm, md and lg (the plan's three breakpoints; no others are defined) | S (~30min / ~5min) | ACCEPTED | In blast radius; directly serves time-to-first-completed-task |
| E5 | Global nav unread badge | M (~1d / ~30min) | DEFERRED | Outside blast radius (global shell); needs an unread-count access path not in the contracts |
| E6 | "New since last visit" divider | M (~2d / ~45min) | DEFERRED | Needs persistence; plan forbids schema changes; client-only variant is lossy across devices |
| E7 | Prefetch dashboard payload on the login response | M (~1d / ~30min) | DEFERRED | Touches the auth flow; decide after R12's staging latency numbers (endpoint p95/p99) show the extra round trip matters |
| E8 | Act-then-undo instead of the confirmation modal for "Mark all as read" | S (~3h / ~15min) if a bulk un-read API exists; **M (~1d / ~45min) otherwise**, because undo needs a server path to restore read state for the snapshot range, and the plan forbids schema changes and new mutation APIs | HELD → User Challenge UC1; **default: confirmation modal stands** | Changes the user's stated design; both reviewer voices favor it; user decides at the final gate with the effort caveat in view |
| E9 | Smart post-login redirect when exactly one assigned item | M (~1d / ~20min) | DEFERRED | A treatment arm for the cohort experiment, not part of this plan; touches the login flow |

**Pre-gate check for UC1:** whether a member-scoped bulk un-read API exists could not be verified during this review (this repository holds no application source). The user or implementer confirms it before deciding UC1 so the decision is made against a known effort, not a range.

## Accepted Scope (added to this plan)
- E1 focus/visibility refetch with 60s throttle, stale-while-revalidate, request-level errors on refetch keep stale data + error toast, suppressed during an in-flight mutation
- E2 relative timestamps with `<time dateTime>` and `title`
- E3 empty-state CTAs as specified per panel above, with the eligibility fallback
- E4 QuickActions first in DOM and visual order at sm/md/lg
- Hardening of the baseline: the aggregate handler fans out to the three repository calls **in parallel**, each with a 2s timeout (worst case ≈2s, not 6s), returns a per-panel `{status, data | error}` envelope, and 503 only when all three fail; shared `usePanelState` hook; shared toast primitive; production-measured baseline before targets lock; kill criterion and cohort gates; observability, performance checks and full test matrix (R1-R14 in the active plan)

### Why the toast and panel-state hook are shared, not page-local
Second consumers exist inside this plan already: the toast region is used by the mark-all-read success/error path, by quick-action failures, and by background-refetch errors (E1); the accessibility policy requires a single live region per app, which forces app-root mounting regardless. `usePanelState` is consumed by three panels. Neither depends on E8/UC1.

## Deferred to TODOS.md (= R15 in the active plan)
- Global nav unread badge (E5) — needs an indexed unread-count query; P2
- "New since last visit" divider (E6) — blocked by schema-change approval or an explicit lossy client-storage decision; P3
- Prefetch dashboard payload on login (E7) — revisit after R12 staging latency numbers; P3
- Smart post-login redirect experiment (E9) — a treatment arm for the cohort experiment; P3

## Alternatives considered
- A) Smart redirect + nav badge (minimal, completeness 4/10): does nothing for members with 0 or 2+ assigned items; leaves the three-page hunt for alerts and history.
- B) Dashboard + one aggregate endpoint with per-panel envelopes (**recommended**, 9/10): one round trip, one auth check, partial failure is a first-class contract. Adopted as the working approach; the final gate can still switch to C (taste decision T1).
- C) Dashboard + three panel-scoped endpoints (8/10): fully independent panels at the cost of three round trips and three handlers.

## Open items for the final gate
- UC1: confirmation modal (user's design, stands by default) vs act-then-undo; effort depends on whether a bulk un-read API exists (see E8 and the pre-gate check).
- T1: aggregate endpoint with envelopes (recommended) vs per-panel endpoints.
- T2: ship all three panels behind the flag (recommended) vs QuickActions-only first.
